evidence: Current source review only; evaluation accounts, fixtures, outputs, scope and institutional approval are UNVERIFIED.

tasks.goal: Sign in to the assigned applicant account
tasks.capability: Access key + matching birthdate; applicant own-account scope
tasks.scope: Own identity only; key remains reusable until revoked/reissued
tasks.prerequisites: Assigned synthetic identity and active access challenge
tasks.outcome: Authenticated own portal session
tasks.limitations: Authentication is not inquiry eligibility. Login defaults are not verified evaluation credentials; no mobile-use proof.

tasks.capability: Authenticated applicant own-record access
tasks.scope: Own ApplicantIdentity and admission attempt
tasks.prerequisites: Assigned account and actual synthetic attempt
tasks.outcome: Current status/milestones are displayed
tasks.limitations: A status label depends on real fixture state; the guide does not set it.

tasks.goal: Ask the supplied admission question and read its reply
tasks.capability: Applicant office-inquiry capability plus explicit synthetic actor registration
tasks.scope: Own inquiry; allowed Registrar/Guidance destination and active eligible attempt
tasks.prerequisites: Purpose-specific inquiry actor registration, matching institution/cycle and permitted staff counterpart
tasks.outcome: An inquiry/message is created and a permitted reply can be read
tasks.limitations: Ordinary portal demo accounts are not automatically registered for inquiries. Unregistered index is unavailable; private resources/writes fail closed. Reply and evaluation actor readiness are unverified.

tasks.capability: Applicant own-portal read
tasks.scope: Own current attempt notice projection
tasks.prerequisites: A synthetic state that actually produces the required notice
tasks.outcome: The relevant notice is visible
tasks.limitations: A normal pending/accepted account may have no notice. Absence is unavailable fixture, not a Neutral rating.

tasks.capability: Authenticated applicant own-assignment read
tasks.scope: Own eligible attempt and assignment
tasks.prerequisites: Accepted synthetic attempt with the prepared exam assignment/session
tasks.outcome: Assigned date, room and permit information are readable
tasks.limitations: Research task is schedule inspection, not applicant slot booking. Missing assignment must remain unavailable.

tasks.goal: Read the physical result sheet in face-to-face consultation
tasks.workspace: Physical paper provided by authorized staff; not an online result route
tasks.capability: Approved face-to-face physical artifact handling
tasks.scope: Assigned synthetic paper only
tasks.prerequisites: Actual generated and printed result sheet from prepared ordinary scoring
tasks.outcome: Participant reads the supplied paper information
tasks.limitations: No online score-view substitute. A generated PDF or print receipt alone does not prove delivery. Physical output remains unverified.

tasks.capability: registrar.applications.view
tasks.scope: Current permitted institution/office/cycle records
tasks.prerequisites: Assigned synthetic intake and Registrar account with current grant
tasks.outcome: Intake list/detail is readable
tasks.limitations: Job title does not grant authority. Actual account and fixture scope still require purpose-specific verification.

tasks.capability: registrar.applications.view
tasks.scope: Permitted admission dossier, not confidential assessment or counselling data
tasks.prerequisites: Synthetic identity/attempt and required intake/consent relationships
tasks.outcome: Permitted dossier and current record state are shown
tasks.limitations: Technical read only. Do not widen this to raw scores or clinical notes.

tasks.capability: registrar.enrollment.eligibility
tasks.scope: Permitted milestone facts and eligibility, not raw assessment/clinical fields
tasks.prerequisites: Assigned synthetic attempt in a state meaningful for the task
tasks.outcome: Eligibility and missing milestones are shown
tasks.limitations: Lookup does not enroll the applicant or prove milestones complete. The query search/card shown here has no actor institution/cycle filter; route capability alone does not prove row-level isolation. Verify isolation before evaluation and record this gap, do not widen access.

tasks.capability: registrar.applications.correct
tasks.scope: Permitted pending attempt with matching expected version
tasks.prerequisites: A separate pending correction fixture and a valid reason
tasks.outcome: Allowed correction request changes state to needs_correction
tasks.limitations: An accepted case prepared for eligibility is not necessarily eligible for correction. Preserve stale/state denial, do not change the case to force success.

tasks.capability: registrar.enrollment.eligibility
tasks.scope: Authorized lifecycle/program/follow-up facts only
tasks.prerequisites: Prepared synthetic milestones and allowed handoff data
tasks.outcome: Permitted readiness and handoff facts are readable
tasks.limitations: Registrar is not a private Guidance/academic thread participant. Do not infer thread content or grant access from this task. The eligibility query's row-level institution/cycle filtering is not established; approved isolated synthetic case readiness is still required.

tasks.workspace: Assigned eligibility/handoff view; Registrar inquiry queue only if explicitly part of the prepared case
tasks.capability: Registrar eligibility grant or current Registrar office-inquiry handling authority
tasks.scope: Current office and assigned synthetic case
tasks.prerequisites: Owner-approved coordination fixture and exact allowed action
tasks.outcome: Permitted status coordination or office inquiry outcome is observed
tasks.limitations: The protocol permits information OR action; no broad messaging right is implied. Exact prepared path and eligibility query row-level isolation remain unverified; no private counselling thread substitute.

tasks.goal: Create staff-managed exam session and inspect capacity
tasks.capability: guidance.exam.schedule
tasks.scope: Allowed institution/cycle/room and session lifecycle
tasks.prerequisites: Configured active cycle and valid room/layout/material prerequisites
tasks.outcome: Draft session and capacity information can be inspected
tasks.limitations: No applicant self-booking in this scenario. Draft creation is not publication or readiness proof.

tasks.capability: guidance.scoring.omr; manual access only for its separate permitted operation
tasks.scope: Closed eligible roster and frozen institutional material binding
tasks.prerequisites: Prepared synthetic sheet/capture, current material pair and eligible grading context
tasks.outcome: Ordinary scoring output is inspected
tasks.limitations: Not template calibration, uncertain-mark adjudication or accuracy evaluation. Missing material/identity/eligible roster is blocked; software fixtures do not establish physical qualification.

tasks.capability: Current Guidance support-workspace authority
tasks.scope: Assigned institution/cycle/applicant and permitted advising projection
tasks.prerequisites: Finalized profile and approved current benchmark/provider output
tasks.outcome: Advisory match options and explanations can be reviewed
tasks.limitations: Provider code can report in_process_heuristics or in_process_fallback when the HTTP sidecar fails. These are not verified TabPFN outputs; confirm prepared inference provenance and do not substitute or claim model performance.

tasks.capability: guidance.consultation.decide and current permitted query scope
tasks.scope: Assigned accepted applicant/queue within allowed institution and cycle
tasks.prerequisites: Prepared attempt, assignment and grading/readiness facts
tasks.outcome: Current testing/consultation milestones are readable
tasks.limitations: Read-only status does not grant Registrar intake edits. Current data/privacy scope and fixture still require verification.

tasks.goal: Send assigned synthetic case message and read leader reply
tasks.workspace: Assigned applicant internal case thread in Consultation/Program Workspace; not /communications announcements
tasks.capability: record.thread.participate plus current Guidance plan/schedule authority
tasks.scope: Active institution/cycle/program, current case relationship and permitted thread type
tasks.prerequisites: Approved same-case thread, current eligible parties and separate browser identities
tasks.outcome: Permitted message/reply exchange is recorded
tasks.limitations: Paired with D4. No Registrar/private-clinical access or assumed Guidance+PH+Dean membership. Actual thread eligibility is unverified.

tasks.capability: guidance.consultation.decide; additional pool/referral grants for those branches
tasks.scope: Accepted current-ready pre-enrollment case and permitted counselling purpose
tasks.prerequisites: Prepared current result, active F2F context and attributable current print evidence as required
tasks.outcome: Allowed consultation decision and related receipt are recorded
tasks.limitations: Prepared PDF is not physical print evidence. No online/Jitsi substitution. Branch scope, current evidence and state gates remain authoritative.

tasks.goal: Deliver physical result sheet and inspect permitted record
tasks.capability: guidance.results.release for physical print confirmation
tasks.scope: Current authorized result document and F2F purpose
tasks.prerequisites: Finalized grades, current generated document/template, actual printed paper and permitted delivery context
tasks.outcome: Physical sheet is delivered; allowed print-confirmation record can be inspected
tasks.limitations: MarkResultSheetsPrinted records print confirmations/corrections, not an independently observed recipient handover. Do not call a print receipt proof of delivery or use online release; exact delivery evidence remains a task-readiness gate.

tasks.goal: Inspect assigned roster and record attendance
tasks.capability: Current permitted conduct capability/duty through ProctorDutyGate
tasks.scope: Assigned session/examinee and allowed attendance window
tasks.prerequisites: Prepared nonterminal session/assignment and verified actor duty
tasks.outcome: Permitted attendance outcome is recorded
tasks.limitations: Scheduling access alone must not be assumed sufficient for every duty/state. No grading overwrite or setup task substitution.

tasks.capability: program.head.view with current program/academic ownership scope
tasks.scope: Only currently assigned or owned active program/department
tasks.prerequisites: Purpose-specific academic account and current synthetic quota/cycle facts
tasks.outcome: Permitted capacity/commitment/headroom information is readable
tasks.limitations: A Program Head or Dean title does not authorize the full institution catalog or all quota mutations.

tasks.goal: Locate assigned applicant in program list
tasks.capability: program.head.view and current relationship/privacy query boundary
tasks.scope: In-scope accepted candidate and allowed displayed fields
tasks.prerequisites: Synthetic accepted case matching permitted preference/pool/selection relationship
tasks.outcome: The allowed candidate entry and state can be inspected
tasks.limitations: Pre-accepted identities and foreign programs must not be inferred or exposed. Full raw scoring/clinical fields are not implied.

tasks.capability: program.head.view; resolution is a separate capability/action
tasks.scope: Only referral targeted to current program/academic ownership
tasks.prerequisites: Prepared open ProgramFollowUp and eligible scoped actor
tasks.outcome: Permitted referral information is readable
tasks.limitations: Review is not clearance/resolution. Missing targeted referral is unavailable, not an invented case.

tasks.goal: Read Guidance message and reply on the same approved case
tasks.workspace: Assigned internal case thread through Program Workspace/applicant support
tasks.capability: record.thread.participate with current permitted program party
tasks.scope: Active institution/cycle/program and current case relationship
tasks.prerequisites: Paired C5 case/thread, actual permitted membership and separate actor session
tasks.outcome: Academic leader reads and sends the permitted reply
tasks.limitations: Only eligible PH OR Dean for the approved case. No role impersonation, Registrar access, three-party widening or privacy certification from the role label.
